title: Phasor and impedance visualiser
summary: See what a series or parallel RLC circuit does in sinusoidal steady state: element voltages or branch currents drawn tip to tail as rotating phasors, the impedance plane (and the admittance plane in parallel), waveforms projected from the rotating arrows, and an optional power triangle, with every number in a readout and a live sentence saying whether current lags or leads. Handles resonance without infinities, keeps the circuit in the URL, exports a Markdown report, a beamdswitch deck, JSON and SVG, checks itself on every load and runs offline. Ideal components only.
